[1] Bethel Memorial Church, also known as Bethel Baptist Memorial Church, is a historic Baptist church building located at White Post, Clarke County, Virginia.
[2] The Crimea Memorial Church, also known as "Christ Church", is a Church of England church in the Beyoglu - Taksim district of Istanbul, Turkey.
[3] National Baptist Memorial Church is a Baptist church in Washington, D.C. It is located at the intersection of 16th Street NW and Columbia Road, where the Mt. Pleasant, Columbia Heights and Adams Morgan neighborhoods meet.
[4] The Khedive Palace (Turkish: "Hıdiv Kasrı" ) or Çubuklu Palace ("Çubuklu Sarayı"), located on the Asian side of the Bosphorus in Istanbul, Turkey, was a former residence of Khedive Abbas II of Egypt and Sudan.
